title: Parity of the Negative Odd Power Function f(x) = x^(-5)
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Determine whether the function f(x) = x^(-5) is even, odd, or neither, and give reasons for your answer.

steps.title: Write the Negative Exponent as a Reciprocal
steps.explanation: Express x^(-5) as 1 / x^5 on its symmetric domain (-inf, 0) U (0, inf).
steps.why: By definition of negative exponents, x^(-n) = 1 / x^n for x != 0.

steps.title: Evaluate f(-x)
steps.explanation: Raising -x to the odd power 5 produces (-x)^5 = -x^5, so f(-x) = -x^(-5) = -f(x).
steps.why: An odd power of a negative quantity retains the negative sign: (-1)^5 = -1.

steps.title: Conclude Function Parity
steps.explanation: Because f(-x) = -f(x) for all x != 0, f(x) = x^(-5) is an odd function.
steps.why: Satisfying f(-x) = -f(x) throughout a symmetric domain defines an odd function.
